toast.$description: Transient, self-dismissing feedback — 'toast' is the industry-standard name for exactly this pattern (Radix Toast, shadcn's toast, Sonner, Material's Snackbar, Ant Design's `message` are all the same idea with different positions/stacking); 'notification' in most libraries means the richer, longer-lived card with a title, body and actions, which this deliberately is NOT (deferred until a real surface needs one). One line: role icon + text, floating top-center over the page, auto-dismissing on a timer. Three roles per the driving request — success / danger / warning — with icon colors from the status.* semantic group, whose own $description reserves it for exactly this use ('badges, alerts, form validation'); first consumer of that group. The shell reuses Popover's floating recipe (surface.default + border.default + shadow.sm + radius.default): it floats, so it gets a shadow (allowed — floating-UI family), and carries a crisp hairline edge. Implementation is native-first like every overlay in this system: popover='manual' + showPopover() — free top-layer, and 'manual' opts OUT of light-dismiss (a toast dismisses itself on a timer, not on outside clicks) — with a @starting-style entry transition. Built 2026-07-24 for the Student Message Center prototype's archive confirmation. 2026-10-27: an info role; a two-line form (title + description); an action (Undo) with a close (×); and a timer — a thin bar along the bottom that drains while the toast is up and pauses while the pointer or focus is on it (WCAG 2.2.1: the user can stop the clock). Still deferred: a stacking manager (a new toast replaces the one showing). Its icon per role (success / danger → error / warning) is the shared StatusIcon since 2026-10-27; the toast's own role colour tokens were removed.

offsetTop.$description: Distance from the top edge of the viewport to the toast — top-center placement per the driving request.

title.$description: The first line of a two-line toast.

description.$description: The second line — what it means or what happens next.

maxWidth.$description: 480px — past this the description wraps; a one-liner stays as wide as its text.

actionGap.$description: 12px text → action. The action is Button tint sm (low-emphasis brand blue — an Undo, never a second primary); the × is Button ghost sm icon-only.

timer.$description: A 2px bar along the bottom edge that drains over the toast's life; pauses on hover / focus.

duration.$description: How long a toast stays — literal ms, like the other motion values.

withAction.$description: Long enough to read it and reach Undo.

labelLineHeight.$description: 20px — the one-line label's line, declared so the toast is 44px (12 + 20 + 12) on the 4px grid; 14px × 1.4 would be 19.6.

textLineHeight.$description: 16px — the title's and description's lines in a two-line toast (12px text), so 12 + 16 + 4 + 16 + 12 = 60.
